name: Thermodynamics
description: Properties of substances (pure and mixtures), thermodynamic property relations, energy transfer by heat and work, ideal and real processes, the laws of thermodynamics and their applications to a control volume, and the application of these concepts to understand the functioning of various practical energy systems. Analysis of energy systems from a first-principles basis. Laboratory component: demonstration of classroom concepts through demo experiments and lab exercises.
